title: 第21章 最后一轮对战叶青第22章 碾压叶青剑指苏清雪
content_zh:
第四战台上，众人的目光皆是聚集在此处。
这一场比斗的结果，显然是出乎了所有人的预料。
炼体七重的叶宇，竟然在极短的时间内便被叶无尘废去了修为。
在此之前，所有人都认为叶无尘是靠一些肮脏的手段才走到这一步的。
可如今，场上的众人再也不知道该说些什么才能表达他们此刻的心情。
谁说叶无尘此次参加族比是来丢人的。
他仿佛在用这一战告诉在场的众人。
他叶无尘，便是要在今日，再次绽放出那一抹属于自己的光芒。
看台上，苏家家主苏山河跟苏清雪皆是一脸震惊。
不过苏清雪很快就平静了下来，叶宇的实力固然不错，不过对于她来说，依旧是太低了一点。
“叶无尘，你找死！”
看台之上，一股强大的杀意将叶无尘牢牢锁定着。
叶玉涛整个人竟直接朝叶无尘所在的方向冲了过来。
然而，就在叶玉涛刚刚踏入擂台范围的时候，叶苍却是挡在了他的身前。
“叶玉涛，你是想坏了我叶家的规矩吗？”
听闻此话，叶玉涛低喝一声，“规矩？你问问他叶无尘有没有规矩，同为叶家弟子，下手却如此狠辣！”
叶无尘与叶宇同属于叶家弟子，叶玉涛此话倒也有一点道理。
但也仅仅是有一点道理，虽是同族之人，但叶宇刚刚散发出来的杀意在场的诸位有谁看不出来？
如今被叶无尘废去修为，再谈同族情谊，确实有些太过好笑了。
叶玉涛此时已然被愤怒冲昏了理智，只见他往前踏出一步，随即一拳朝叶苍轰出。

恐怖的力道直接让演武场上空响起了一道音爆之声。
然而，面对这恐怖的一击，叶苍仅是轻轻的伸了一下手掌便把叶玉涛的拳头死死攥在手心之中。
这样的情景，让众人的目光都凝固在了那里。
“好强的实力，叶家的武痴，果然厉害。”
看台之上，姜战看到这一幕，眸子不由得眯了眯。
以叶苍透露出来的实力来看，对方极有可能已经踏入了聚海四重，甚至更高。
“叶玉涛，看在你护子心切的份上，现在退下，我可以当做什么都没发生过。”
叶苍淡淡开口道。
叶玉涛脸色阴沉的可怕，他刚想说些什么，叶青的声音却先一步响了起来。
“父亲，交给我吧，叶宇的仇，我会帮他报的，叶无尘，会为此付出生命的代价。”
叶青此话倒是把叶玉涛从暴怒的边缘拉了回来。
他这才想起来，叶无尘跟叶青是定下过生死战的。
有叶苍几人在，自己肯定是杀不了叶无尘的。
还不如让自己的儿子在擂台上正大光明的击杀叶无尘。
到时候，就算是家主也没有办法阻止。
一念至此，叶玉涛放弃了击杀叶无尘的想法，他走到擂台边缘，缓缓将叶宇扶了起来。
“父亲，哥，帮我报仇！”
此刻的叶宇心中，难过、悲伤、愤怒、怨恨等一系列负面情绪占据着他整个身心。
不同于手臂，丹田若是被废了，也就代表着他这一辈子再也无法习武了。
一想到此处，叶宇看向叶无尘，眸中的恨意越来越浓烈。

擂台中心处，与众人的震惊不同，作为冲突中心的叶无尘内心却是十分平静。
在他动手废去叶宇丹田之时就已经预料到此时会发生的事情了。
事情的发展，与他内心所预测的基本没有出入。
“叶苍长老，开始下一个阶段吧。”
擂台中心，叶无尘催促道。
content_en:
On the fourth stage, everyone's eyes are focused on this place.
The result of this battle was obviously beyond everyone's expectations.
Ye Yu, who was at the seventh level of body refining, was deprived of his cultivation by Ye Wuchen in a very short period of time.
Before this, everyone thought that Ye Wuchen had reached this point through some dirty means.
But now, everyone on the field no longer knows what to say to express their feelings at the moment.
Who said that Ye Wuchen participated in the clan competition this time to embarrass himself.
He seemed to be using this battle to tell everyone present.
Ye Wuchen wanted to shine his own light again today.
In the stands, the heads of the Su family, Su Shanhe and Su Qingxue, both looked shocked.
But Su Qingxue calmed down quickly. Although Ye Yu's strength was good, it was still a little too low for her.
"Ye Wuchen, you are looking for death!"
Above the stands, a powerful killing intent locked Ye Wuchen tightly.
Ye Yutao actually rushed directly towards the direction of Ye Wuchen.
However, just when Ye Yutao stepped into the arena, Ye Cang stood in front of him.
"Ye Yutao, do you want to break the rules of my Ye family?"
Hearing this, Ye Yutao shouted, "Rules? Ask Ye Wuchen if he has any rules. He is also a disciple of the Ye family, but he is so ruthless!"
Ye Wuchen and Ye Yu were both disciples of the Ye family, so Ye Yutao's words made sense.
But it only makes sense. Although they are members of the same clan, who among the people present could not see the killing intent that Ye Yu just exuded?
Now that Ye Wuchen has abandoned his cultivation, it is indeed too funny to talk about the friendship between the same clan.
Ye Yutao was overwhelmed by anger at this time. He took a step forward and then punched Ye Cang.
The terrifying force directly caused a sonic boom to sound over the martial arts field.
However, facing this terrifying blow, Ye Cang just stretched out his palm slightly and tightly grasped Ye Yutao's fist in his palm.
Such a scene made everyone's eyes fixed there.
"So strong. The martial arts idiots of the Ye family are really powerful."
On the stands, Jiang Zhan couldn't help but narrowed his eyes when he saw this scene.
Judging from the strength revealed by Ye Cang, the opponent has most likely reached the fourth level of Juhai, or even higher.
"Ye Yutao, for the sake of your eagerness to protect your son, stand down now. I can pretend that nothing has happened."
Ye Cang said calmly.
Ye Yutao's face was gloomy and scary. He was about to say something, but Ye Qing's voice sounded first.
"Father, leave it to me. I will avenge Ye Yu's revenge. Ye Wuchen will pay the price with his life."
Ye Qing's words brought Ye Yutao back from the edge of rage.
Only then did he remember that Ye Wuchen and Ye Qing had decided to fight to the death.
With Ye Cang and the others around, he definitely couldn't kill Ye Wuchen.
It would be better to let his son kill Ye Wuchen openly in the ring.
When the time comes, even the head of the family will have no way to stop it.
With this thought, Ye Yutao gave up the idea of ​​killing Ye Wuchen. He walked to the edge of the ring and slowly helped Ye Yu up.
"Father, brother, help me take revenge!"
At this moment, Ye Yu's heart was filled with a series of negative emotions such as sadness, sadness, anger, and resentment, occupying his entire body and mind.
Unlike his arms, if his Dantian is destroyed, it means that he will never be able to practice martial arts again in his life.
When he thought of this, Ye Yu looked at Ye Wuchen, the hatred in his eyes getting stronger and stronger.
In the center of the arena, unlike everyone's shock, Ye Wuchen, who was at the center of the conflict, was very calm inside.
When he started to destroy Ye Yu's Dantian, he had already expected what would happen at this time.
The development of things was basically the same as what he had predicted.
"Elder Ye Cang, let's start the next stage.. "
In the center of the arena, Ye Wuchen urged.
